scope: Training-side mechanism screen inside outer-fold1 training users3..8. Users1/2 excluded entirely from RF access and fitting. Six leave-one-source-user-out nuisance checks; not the six-source classification protocol, not accuracy.
fit: For each user, all retained class11 empty clips, per-clip/per-view RMS normalization floor1e-12, average90frame outer products. No extra temporal/feature centering. For each held source user average other five user moments equally, eigenbasis at smallest rank explaining90% energy. Do not truncate rank to32: report capacity-gate failure when rank exceeds32. Fit18 bases independently (six users x three radars).
diagnostic: Held source user first20 sorted sample IDs per present quality-retained class, including empty11. User6 class3 excluded by existing quality rule. Each clip residual energy fraction1-||XU||F^2/||X||F^2. Active mean equals mean of class0..10 per-class means; empty class11 separately. Labels used only for fixed stratification and summarizing source diagnostic, never selecting eigenbasis/rank/seed.
controls: Identity retains1. Fixed Gaussian-QR random orthogonal basis with exactly matching rank, seed[20261007,held_source,view]; compare active-empty retention contrast, not raw attenuation alone.
gate: Each source/view cell must satisfy all: rank<=32, empty retention<=.2, active retention>=.5, active-empty>=.3 and contrast minus random contrast>=.2. A fixed radar qualifies if at least4/6source users pass; at least one radar required to justify a separately preregistered classifier study. These are prospective engineering criteria, not literature-optimal or statistical significance thresholds.
stop: If no radar qualifies, close this fixed90%-energy empty-eigenspace removal screen; no rank/threshold/normalization/seed grid or classifier/eightfold expansion from it. A pass is mechanism eligibility only and requires new same-protocol classifier baselines/ablations before efficacy claims.
limits: Energy overlap is not known nuisance/gesture decomposition. Removing high activity energy can still leave discriminative low-energy information; failing this proxy does not disprove all subspace filtering.
Input is dataset ClutterRemoved real RF, not unprocessed Raw ADC, not calibrated complex IQ or Doppler-angle snapshots.
Empty gestures include system pulse response and body/background echoes; no pure-noise ground truth.

Class sampling first20 is fixed reproducible subsampling and may retain acquisition-order bias. Source users are historically reused and the six fitted bases share training users; no independent external evidence or confidence claims.

Known eigencancellation, not RPCA, Liu2018 STAP replication or original research contribution. Prior empty-spectrum whitening failure motivates checking its nuisance-identifiability premise; this is a distinct uncentered range-basis selectivity diagnostic, not relabeled classification improvement.
